description:
Build to something to be proud of. 

 
 Captivation has built a reputation on providing customers exactly what is needed in a timely manner. Our team of engineers take pride in what they develop and constantly innovate to provide the best solution. Captivation is looking for software developers who can get stuff done while making a difference in support of the mission to protect our country. 

  

 Description 

 
 Captivation Software has an immediate need for need for a Platform Engineer to support the project and lead the deployment of the production system across three network environments. This is a hybrid role for a versatile, jack-of-all-trades engineer who is equally comfortable deploying and operating containerized systems via Kubernetes and diving into application code to modify system components. The ideal candidate thrives on ownership, working across the full stack and the full deployment lifecycle to stand up new production environments. 

  

 Responsibilities 

 
 
 Multi-Network Deployment: Deploy the RAD system to three different network environments via Kubernetes, adapting configurations to the constraints of each network. 

 Deployment Process Engineering: Design, establish, and document a repeatable deployment process and pipeline for delivering the system and its updates across all target networks. 

 Application Modification: Modify and troubleshoot system components built with Java Spring (back-end) and Vue.js (front-end) as needed to support deployment, configuration, and environment-specific requirements. 

 Environment Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve issues spanning infrastructure, middleware, and application layers during environment standup and stabilization. 

 Collaboration: Work closely with the existing DevOps team, software developers, and system engineers to align deployment practices with the broader RAD architecture and operational standards. 

 
  

 Requirements 

 
 Security Clearance: 

 
 Must currently hold a Top Secret/SCI U.S. Government security clearance with a favorable Polygraph, therefore all candidates must be a U.S. citizen 

 
 Minimum Qualifications: 

 
 Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university.

 Master’s degree can be substituted for two (2) years experience

 
 Required Skills: 

 
 Hands-on experience deploying and managing containerized applications with Kubernetes

 Experience developing or modifying applications built with Java / Spring (Spring Boot)

 Experience developing or modifying front-end applications built with Vue.js (or strong experience with a comparable framework such as React or Angular)

 Thorough understanding of Docker and container technology

 Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployments of distributed web applications (e.g., GitLab CI/CD)

 Linux administration experience

 Experience with Git

 
 Desired Skills: 

 
 Experience deploying applications across multiple isolated or classified network environments

 AWS experience, including cloud-native architecture and deployment

 Terraform scripting and VM provisioning

 Ansible scripting and development

 Python scripting and development

 Familiarity with Elasticsearch, NiFi, or MongoDB

 Familiarity with domain knowledge surrounding government agency reporting and dissemination policies

 
  

 This position is open for direct hires only. We will not consider candidates from third party staffing/recruiting firms. 
 Benefits 

 
 
 Annual Salary: $130,000 - $270,000 (Depends on the Years of Experience) 

 Up to 20% 401k contribution (No Matching Required and Vested from Day 1) 

 Above Market Hourly Rates 

 $3,600 HSA Contribution 

 6 Weeks Paid Time Off 

 Company Paid Employee Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance/Life Insurance/Short-Term & Long-Term Disability/AD&D
